payload.summary: Refined roadmap item ri-01 into a coordinated, test-first plan. The selected design repairs optional query serialization in the shared client, preserves strict API cursor validation, and isolates CLI output and tests from ambient state.

decisions.title: Repair the shared client boundary
decisions.rationale: One canonical fix covers CLI and HTTP-mode MCP callers without weakening server validation.

decisions.title: Treat the approved roadmap as both planning gates
decisions.rationale: The parent roadmap already records explicit acceptance outcomes, constraints, and approved status.

next_steps: Implement wp-transport, wp-cli-output, wp-test-isolation, and wp-runtime-hygiene before integration.
